description: This file implements the PersistentStore class for a plugin in the WPEFramework, providing methods for managing key-value storage, including setting, getting, deleting keys/namespaces, and managing storage limits. It registers and unregisters RPC endpoints and interacts with underlying storage and cache components.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: A class providing RPC endpoints for managing persistent key-value storage, including CRUD operations, namespace management, cache flushing, and storage limits.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints for persistent storage operations.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the store for a given key and namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key and namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves storage sizes per namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes for all namespaces.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets the storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets the storage limit for a namespace.
